_about: Six made-up users for the word-list benchmark (tools/vocab/make_personas.py). Each has the places the daemon can read names from (folders, a project, apps, contacts, recent files, the screen) and sentences with names a speech model is likely to misspell. 'names' are scored; 'ordinary' sentences have none and catch damage.
